doc.inspiration: Virtual Riot 'Pendulum Sequence 2' (Ableton, 'I heard you like polyrhythms'): pattern idea only, original synthesis
doc.formula: MEASURED (see pendulum/timing-analysis.md): lane i (0 = top note) repeats with frequency f_i = f0*(N-i)/N, f0 = 1/topPeriodBeats beats; equivalently period grows ~+0.245%/lane going down (linear-period and linear-frequency fits are indistinguishable, resid <1 px). All lanes realign every N top-lane cycles = N*topPeriod.
doc.staircaseOffsetSec: lane i is delayed by i*staircaseOffsetSec, so at every realign the figure is a clean descending arpeggio
doc.analysis: Measured from video frames (pixel run-lengths of piano-roll notes, 3 zoom levels): 30 BPM 4/4, 35 lanes E1..E8 (folded, E-minor/G-major set w/o C below E4 partly), top period 0.50 beat, +0.245%/lane, bottom/top 1.083, note length 0.37 x lane period, all lanes start together (staircase = drift). Spectrum readout ~786 Hz (G5+4c) peak, dark mix.
